description: Control case: chat and RFP agree. The RFP lists several objectives, so the goal is ambiguous and needs the user to pick one. Nothing else needs the user.
chat: I need a plan for Summit Ridge Outdoors for the spring-summer 2027 season, $1,000,000 total. PDF brief attached. Don't run on Vortex Stream.

target_audience: Primary: U.S. adults 25-54 who hike, camp or spend regular time outdoors and buy gear and apparel; reached as households on connected TV (about 80% of budget)
Secondary: adults 55-64, household income $100K+, interested in road trips, birding and fly fishing (about 20% of budget)
expected.audience_provider_restriction: Meridian Audience Data only, for third-party audience data
buying_preferences: Brand-safe, family-appropriate content at or below TV-PG
Outdoor, travel and lifestyle programming preferred

conflicts.note: RFP lists several objectives (reach and frequency, site traffic and purchases, learning which environments work). The plan needs one goal metric.
